verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a dedicated Patents practice page describing 'strategic patent advice rooted in deep sector knowledge, technical expertise, and cross-border experience' with lawyers having scientific/engineering backgrounds, and emphasizes capacity to handle multiple complex UPC litigation cases — showing a documented patents group. However, the evidence emphasizes litigation/advice and UPC disputes rather than the specific mechanics of drafting/filing applications or portfolio strategy, and no named individual practitioners are cited. Missing for 10: explicit mention of patent drafting/filing services, portfolio management/strategy language, and named practitioner bios or team member pages.
